draft_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
rationale: The package contains only exp1 (original labels, 5 seeds) and Table T1. There are no noise-perturbation experiments, no T2 table, and no reported F1 drops at 10%/20%/30% noise. The cited evidence IDs (T2.r1–r3) do not exist in the package. The claim is entirely unsupported.
